# Implementation Manager

Company: Linear
Location: Remote US
Compensation: $130,000 - $170,000 base

Linear is hiring an Implementation Manager to take customers from signed deal through onboarding, workflow setup, and successful product adoption.

## Responsibilities

- Own customer implementation: discovery, onboarding plans, walkthroughs, and go-live readiness.
- Translate customer workflows into product configuration, documentation, and training.
- Partner with product and engineering; feed adoption issues back as product improvements.
- Build repeatable implementation playbooks, self-service guides, and success metrics.
- Facilitate workshops with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

## Requirements

- Experience in implementation, customer onboarding, product operations, or customer education.
- Evidence of delivering training and documentation that helped teams adopt software.
- Comfort with AI-native product workflows, agent tools, and technical writing.
- Strong project coordination, stakeholder management, and written communication.
- Startup or B2B SaaS implementation experience is a plus.

This is an implementation / product-operations role, not a quota-carrying sales role.
